challenges.evidence: Attio’s status history records delays processing bulk record deletions beginning October 6, 2026, and resolution on October 12. This is a resolved incident, not evidence of an ongoing outage.
challenges.challenge: Bulk-record processing reliability: a recent deletion-processing backlog.

challenges.evidence: Attio reported delays processing formula attribute invalidations on October 6, 2026, warning that some formulas could show outdated values. It marked the issue resolved and the backlog fully processed on October 7.
challenges.challenge: Data freshness: delayed formula updates during a now-resolved incident.

priorities.evidence: The October announcement launched SQL Engine, Data Connectors, Agent Scale, and Activities in beta, describing a single architecture built for people and agents.
priorities.priority: Build agent-native CRM infrastructure with shared customer context and scalable data access.

priorities.evidence: The release’s stated aim was to put more processes on autopilot; it added direct Slack messaging, searchable workflow variables, and team-wide actions.
priorities.priority: Automate more revenue processes through Workflows.

priorities.evidence: Under “Connect more of your stack,” Attio added Google Sheets, Asana, and Hunter workflow capabilities and in-builder app installation.
priorities.priority: Expand ecosystem connectivity and reduce friction when building cross-tool workflows.

priorities.evidence: Workspace admins gained self-service call-recorder disabling, visibility and control over automatically protected email domains, and consistent email blocklist rules.
priorities.priority: Strengthen workspace administration and communication-data controls.
